name: GlazeWM
summary: i3-inspired tiling window manager for Windows (and macOS), configured in one YAML file. Gaps, focused and unfocused border colors, window rules and keybindings all live in the same file; keyboard shortcuts are built in, no separate hotkey daemon.

install.notes: Needs the extras bucket: scoop bucket add extras

windows.notes: No config validator is documented: a config that fails to parse is reported when GlazeWM starts or reloads. The default config is generated on first launch (optional prompt). The status bar is a separate app (Zebar, optional checkbox in the installer). Window borders and rounded corners need Windows 11. Elevated (admin/UAC) windows cannot be managed by a non-elevated window manager (general Windows limit, not stated in the GlazeWM docs). Latest release v3.10.1 (2026-03-21); the tray 'Run on system startup' option was broken before v3.10.1. The glazewm command may not be on PATH after install; the CLI is the same executable.

macos.notes: macOS support exists (v3.10 release notes) but the recipes here are written and sourced for Windows only; window_effects borders are Windows 11 only.

borders.notes: Focused and non-focused window border colors via window_effects, Windows 11 only. Border width is not configurable.

layouts.notes: Tree of horizontal/vertical splits steered by the tiling direction; no named layouts and no automatic layout switching (community scripts exist).
